_doc: Rule sets for the Decision model calibration (scripts/calibration/README.md). Refs follow Shoo's R/K numbering. A holds the Topic starter rules from src/locales/en.yml starter.*.text in starter order. The fifth starter, 'Shorts', is an Exact rule (kind 'short', src/ui/pages/rules.ts STARTERS) that Shoo matches locally and never sends to the model, so it is not in A. sameAsB maps each A ref to the B ref with the identical text. E is A with R3 relabelled for the intent 'get-rich-quick hype only' (labels.json E, from labellers/getrich-labeller{1,2}.json). Its texts and sameAsB are A's. run.mjs --rule-text R3=<text> tries other R3 wordings against the same labels.

remove.R1: Reaction videos, where someone watches and reacts to other content
remove.R2: Clickbait: exaggerated or misleading titles made to get clicks
remove.R3: Crypto, day trading, or get-rich-quick finance
